svg.aria-label: Tally, an ant, leads a column of ants carrying crumbs across a meadow. The column is wide where the ground is open, and every ant walks at once. Then it narrows to a single twig bridge over a stream, where only one ant can cross at a time and the rest wait in a queue. The bridge is the serial part of the work.
